summary: The diff correctly addresses the prescribed root cause: it adds live_preview configuration to the Contentstack Stack options, reading CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN from env vars. The implementation is minimal (8 lines added) and matches the prescribed fix. Notably, the implementer used `management_token` instead of the prescribed `preview_token` — and the dependency_contract tool confirms this was the RIGHT choice: `management_token` is consumed by the contentstack SDK while `preview_token` is absent from the package entirely. No hardcoded strings or security issues. However, test coverage is missing: the existing test file already tests the identical conditional-spread pattern for CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT, and the new live_preview config needs the same two test scenarios (present when env var set, absent when unset). Verdict: changes_requested due to the missing test coverage for the new feature.

issues.description: No unit tests were added for the new live_preview configuration. The existing test file already tests the analogous conditional-spread pattern for CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT (two tests: one verifying options include fetchOptions when the env var is set, one verifying it's absent when the env var is missing). The new live_preview config follows the same pattern but has zero test coverage — no test verifies that options.live_preview is populated when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is set, nor that it's absent when the env var is missing.
issues.suggestedFix: Add two test cases mirroring the existing CONTENTSTACK_FETCH_TIMEOUT tests: (1) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, require the module, and assert options.live_preview equals { enable: true, host: <value>, management_token: <value> }; (2) leave CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST unset and assert options does not contain live_preview.
